verdict.rationale: Issuing credentials for programmatic access is a fair axis for a government service with machine channels. The evidence shows only coarse, entity-level gating. MeF requires becoming an Authorized e-file Provider through a 45-day, fingerprinted enrollment, and IRIS A2A is gated by a Transmitter Control Code. Nothing shows a user can issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent, and online account access sits behind an ID.me biometric liveness check. The EIN third-party designee rail is a signed paper-style authorization, not an API credential.
